recommendation_summary: Do it now: turn the existing export into an Excel Table and build a PivotTable with Region in rows, Date grouped by month in columns and Sum of net amount in values, so refunds subtract automatically. Each month, paste in the new export, refresh, and check the first run against last month's hand-built numbers. No optional additions now; the agent would revisit the stack only if a second data source or a too-large file appears. Unmet needs: none found, though the agent has not seen the workbook.
